fieldNotes.location: Roster address '703 E Robinson St' and coordinates were wrong (RANGE_INTERPOLATED, landed in residential Knoxville). Web research found the real address: 209 N Godfrey Ln, Knoxville IA 50138, on the east edge of town. Locked center 41.3173,-93.0610 — a single dry-sausage plant (pepperoni/salami, ~150 employees, ~1M lbs/week). The adjacent heavy industrial complex with tanks/cooling towers immediately west of Godfrey Ln is a separate (non-Hormel) facility.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The plant property has a continuous chain-link perimeter fence (confirmed in multiple Street Views, 2026-04). A single gate opening in the fence controls the entrance driveway off Godfrey Lane. No barrier arm clearly resolved, but the fenced perimeter with one defined gated driveway is a controlled entrance. Classified true; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no guard booth — implies kiosk/badge/app check-in. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long open driveway from Godfrey Lane into the parking/dock area holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 10-25 band — dock face along the south building wall with ~8-12 trailers backed in (Street View ent2). Overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 10-25 band — a dedicated trailer drop yard with ~15-20 angled trailer stalls sits south of the plant between the property and the rail line.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Separate trailer-storage lot south of the plant, distinct from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs parallel to the road along the south edge but no spur enters the plant property; classified false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant sits on the east edge of Knoxville (pop ~7,300) surrounded by farmland and scattered industrial — Rural.
